basic_details.job_title: DHS Viluppuram Contract/Temporary Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 42 Posts
basic_details.short_information: District Health Society (Mavatta Sugathara Sangam), Viluppuram, under the State Health Society, Tamil Nadu, has invited applications for 42 Contract/Temporary Staff Nurse posts at CEmONC and SNCU centres in Tindivanam and Viluppuram. Completed applications must be submitted to the District Health Society office, Viluppuram by 5.00 PM on 4 December 2026. Candidates with GNM or B.Sc. Nursing and Tamil Nadu Nursing Council registration, aged up to 50 years, are eligible.

content_sections.heading: About DHS Viluppuram
content_sections.text: The District Health Society, Viluppuram works under the State Health Society, Tamil Nadu, Department of Health and Family Welfare, and its Executive Secretary is the District Health Officer, Viluppuram, with the District Collector as Chairman. According to the notice, a Government Order has been issued under the National Health Mission – Tamil Nadu, NHM (TN), to fill 1695 Staff Nurse posts on contract basis across the state in SNCU and PICU wings, including CEmONC centres, under the Directorate of Medical and Rural Health Services. Of these, 42 posts have been allotted to Viluppuram district.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The model application form can be downloaded from the website https://viluppuram.nic.in . The completed application, with copies of the candidate's original educational certificates and other relevant documents, must be submitted to the District Health Society office at the following address by 5.00 PM on 4 December 2026: Executive Secretary, District Health Society / District Health Officer, District Health Officer Office, Viluppuram. The notice does not mention whether the application should be sent by post or delivered by hand, and it does not mention any text for the envelope. The office website printed on the notice is Dphvpm.nic.in.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: All 42 posts are for Contract/Temporary Staff Nurse. The notice distributes them across four centres as follows: Educational qualification: Diploma in Nursing (GNM) or B.Sc. Nursing from a Government or Government-recognised private nursing college, recognised by the Indian Nursing Council. Registration: Registration with the Tamil Nadu Nursing Council is mandatory. Age limit: Up to 50 years. The notice does not print a cut-off date for age or any age relaxation. Nature of appointment: Purely temporary, on contract basis. Pay: Not specified in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

faq.question: Q1. How many Staff Nurse vacancies are there in DHS Viluppuram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 42 Contract/Temporary Staff Nurse posts: 10 at the CEmONC centre and 3 at the SNCU centre of District Headquarters Hospital, Tindivanam, and 14 at the CEmONC centre and 15 at the SNCU centre of Viluppuram Government Medical College Hospital.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the DHS Viluppuram Staff Nurse application?
faq.answer: Completed applications must be submitted to the District Health Society office, Viluppuram by 5.00 PM on 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the DHS Viluppuram Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Diploma in Nursing (GNM) or B.Sc. Nursing from a Government or Government-recognised private nursing college recognised by the Indian Nursing Council, along with registration with the Tamil Nadu Nursing Council.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the DHS Viluppuram Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Contract/Temporary Staff Nurse post is up to 50 years.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for DHS Viluppuram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Download the model application form from https://viluppuram.nic.in, attach copies of your original educational certificates and relevant documents, and submit it to the Executive Secretary, District Health Society / District Health Officer, District Health Officer Office, Viluppuram by 5.00 PM on 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q6. Is the DHS Viluppuram Staff Nurse job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that the 42 Staff Nurse posts are to be filled purely on a temporary basis, on contract.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the selected Staff Nurses be posted?
faq.answer: The posts are at the CEmONC and SNCU centres of District Headquarters Hospital, Tindivanam and Viluppuram Government Medical College Hospital.

faq.question: Q8. Is Tamil Nadu Nursing Council registration compulsory for the DHS Viluppuram Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice states that registration with the Tamil Nadu Nursing Council is mandatory.

faq.question: Q9. Which documents must be attached to the DHS Viluppuram Staff Nurse application?
faq.answer: Copies of the candidate's original educational certificates and other relevant documents must be attached to the completed application form.
